question: Which restaurants and items should the app show when a customer opens it? Evaluated on the customer's next real order.
context_known_at_request_time: customer history up to the cutoff

validation.use: compare models and choose; same window as singapore-official-validation-v2

final_test.targets: official DHRD test file orders_sg_test.txt, days 76-90
final_test.ranker_fit: same hyperparameters, refit on validation targets (history through day 61)
final_test.policy: run once after validation results are committed; no change to models or features afterwards

target: first order of each customer inside the target window

segments.cold: customer has no order in the history
segments.warm_repeat: history exists and the target restaurant was used before
segments.warm_new: history exists and the target restaurant was never used

restaurant_metrics: hit@10: the restaurant of the real order is among the 10 shown
item_metrics: recall@10 over the items of the real order

restaurant_models.popular_global: most ordered restaurants in the city
restaurant_models.popular_city_recent: most ordered restaurants in the city over the last 14 days of history (reference added after an external review of the test results; no model, feature or parameter changed, and every earlier number reproduces exactly)
restaurant_models.random: 10 restaurants drawn uniformly from those with orders in the history (chance level) (reference added after an external review of the test results; no model, feature or parameter changed, and every earlier number reproduces exactly)
restaurant_models.popular_region: most ordered restaurants in the order's geohash, backed off to the city
restaurant_models.popular_region_slot: most ordered in the geohash and time slot, backed off to region then city
restaurant_models.repeat_then_region_slot: restaurants the customer used (visits, then recency), filled with popular_region_slot
restaurant_models.ranker: LightGBM LambdaRank over candidates from history, region, region-slot and city lists
restaurant_models.ranker_6_plus_discovery_4: ranker's top 6, then 4 positions from popular_region_slot (added after the first validation run, before any test)

item_models.popular_global: most ordered items in the city (the v2 popularity baseline)
item_models.popular_city_recent: most ordered items in the city over the last 14 days of history (reference added after an external review of the test results; no model, feature or parameter changed, and every earlier number reproduces exactly)
item_models.repeat_then_global: items the customer bought (count, then recency), filled with city popularity (the v2 repeat baseline)
item_models.popular_region_slot: most ordered items in the geohash and time slot, backed off to region then city
item_models.repeat_then_region_slot: the customer's items, filled with popular_region_slot
item_models.ranker_items: for the ranked restaurants in order: the customer's items there, then that restaurant's most ordered items, up to 3 per restaurant
item_models.repeat_6_plus_discovery_4: the customer's top 6 items, then 4 positions from region-slot popularity (added after the first validation run, before any test)

limitations: Offline replay of historical choices: it measures whether the real next order would have been shown, not conversion, revenue or satisfaction. Restaurants the customer never saw may still have been ordered elsewhere in the app.
uncertainty: Bootstrap over customers (1000 resamples, percentile 95%); paired for differences (reference added after an external review of the test results; no model, feature or parameter changed, and every earlier number reproduces exactly)
